description: Fixed-scale denoising score matching for predictions of the perturbed-data score, with standardized Gaussian noise targets: 1/2 times the squared score residual summed over event dimensions and reduced across the batch (Song and Ermon, §2.1 Eq. (2), §4.2 Eq. (5); official implementation losses/dsm.py:20-24). Noise sampling and perturbed-input construction remain caller responsibilities.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
sigma = 0.2
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    clean = torch.randn(2, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    noise = torch.randn(2, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(clean + sigma * noise), "noise": synth.Tensor(noise)}
dataset = synth.Spec("score-matching", generator=samples, size=12, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = dataset.for_recipe("regression", split="train", input_field="inputs", target_field="noise", preserve_shape=True)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=2, out_features=2)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="regression", recipe_config={"loss": "score-matching", "loss_kwargs": {"sigma": sigma}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train a score network at a fixed noise scale

name: Denoising score matching loss

parameters.additional parameters: unsupported; any extra keyword parameter raises ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because Gaussian noise targets have no ignored indices
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point predicted score tensor with nonempty shape [B, ...]
parameters.reduction: none returns one scalar per sample after summing event dimensions; mean or sum reduces across the batch (default mean)
parameters.sigma: finite positive Gaussian noise standard deviation for this fixed-scale call (default 0.01)
parameters.targets: standardized Gaussian noise ε paired with each perturbed input x̃=x+σ ε; floating-point tensor matching prediction shape, dtype, and device
